name: clusterctl
description: Cluster API lifecycle CLI — init providers, generate cluster manifests, move and upgrade workload clusters

install_steps: Download clusterctl for your platform from https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api/releases and move it to PATH

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install clusterctl: Download clusterctl for your platform from https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Install Cluster API and provider components into the management cluster (clusterctl init --infrastructure aws). Providers: aws, azure, gcp, vsphere, docker...

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install clusterctl: Download clusterctl for your platform from https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Render a workload-cluster manifest (clusterctl generate cluster mycluster --kubernetes-version v1.30.0 --control-plane-machine-count 1 --worker-machine-count 3)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install clusterctl: Download clusterctl for your platform from https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Fetch a workload cluster's kubeconfig (clusterctl get kubeconfig mycluster > kubeconfig.yaml)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install clusterctl: Download clusterctl for your platform from https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Show a cluster's object tree and conditions (clusterctl describe cluster mycluster)

commands.description: Move Cluster API objects to another management cluster (clusterctl move --to-kubeconfig target.yaml)
